enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed with eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Place the left arm under the pillow. Bend the knees. Straighten the legs. Turn onto the back. Turn the head to the right. Reach out and touch the edge of the pillow. Adjust the pillow with the right hand. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket down to the chest. Stretch both arms forward. Turn onto the back again. Place both hands on the abdomen. Turn the head to the left. Lie still with eyes closed.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing both legs over the side of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Reach to the wall and press the light switch on. Stand in front of the sink. Turn the tap handle to the left. Put both hands under the running water. Rub the hands together. Bend forward and splash water onto the face. Pick up the soap bar. Rub the soap between the palms. Put the soap bar back on the holder. Rub the face with both hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn the tap handle to the right and stop the water. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn the tap on. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn the tap off. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Unscrew the cap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Put the tube down. Raise the toothbrush to the mouth. Brush the upper teeth. Brush the lower teeth. Turn the tap on. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Turn the tap off. Place the toothbrush back in the holder. Wipe the mouth with the towel. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom. Close the door.

Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Take out the eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the carton and eggs on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl. Take out a plate. Close the cupboard door. Place the bowl on the counter. Crack one egg on the edge of the bowl. Pull the shell apart with both hands. Drop the egg into the bowl. Pick up a fork from the drawer. Beat the egg with the fork. Press the toaster lever down with a slice of bread inside. Wait next to the counter. Pick up the bread from the toaster when it pops up. Place the bread on the plate. Pick up the frying pan from the hook. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the beaten egg into the pan. Stir the egg with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the egg onto the plate. Open the refrigerator. Take out the butter. Close the refrigerator. Spread butter on the bread with a knife. Pour milk into a glass. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the egg. Pick up the bread. Bite the bread. Drink the milk. Stand up. Carry the plate and glass to the sink. Place them in the sink. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table. Hang the cloth on the hook.

Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt from the hanger. Take out a pair of trousers. Take out a pair of socks. Lay the clothes on the bed. Take off the pyjama top. Drop it into the laundry basket. Take off the pyjama bottoms. Drop them into the laundry basket. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt from bottom to top. Pick up the trousers. Pull the trousers on. Button the waistband. Zip the fly. Pick up the socks. Sit on the edge of the bed. Pull one sock onto the left foot. Pull the other sock onto the right foot. Stand up. Walk to the dressing table. Pick up the hairbrush. Brush the hair with downward strokes. Put the hairbrush down. Pick up the deodorant. Spray under the left arm. Spray under the right arm. Put the deodorant down. Pick up the watch from the table. Strap the watch onto the left wrist. Close the wardrobe door. Turn off the fan. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing light exercise and setting up home workspace
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Press the light switch on. Push the coffee table to the side with both hands. Stand in the middle of the floor. Raise both arms above the head. Lower the arms to the sides. Repeat the arm raises. Bend forward and touch the floor with both hands. Straighten up. Turn the torso to the left. Turn the torso to the right. Place both hands on the hips. Bend the knees into a squat. Stand up from the squat. Stretch the left arm across the chest. Stretch the right arm across the chest. Roll the shoulders forward. Roll the shoulders backward. Walk to the sofa. Pick up the cushion from the sofa. Place the cushion on the armchair. Walk to the desk. Pull the chair out from under the desk. Sit down on the chair. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button on the laptop. Plug the charger into the laptop. Plug the charger into the wall socket. Adjust the desk lamp head downward. Press the desk lamp switch on. Pick up the mouse. Place the mouse on the mousepad. Pick up the notebook and pen from the shelf. Place them on the desk to the right of the laptop. Pick up the water bottle from the counter. Place the water bottle on the desk. Press the router power button on. Straighten the chair back and sit upright.

Sit down at the desk. Place both hands on the keyboard. Type on the keyboard. Move the right hand to the mouse. Click the mouse button. Scroll the mouse wheel. Open the email application. Read the first email. Type a reply on the keyboard. Click the send button with the mouse. Open the calendar window. Click on a meeting block with the mouse. Type meeting notes in the document. Pick up the water bottle. Unscrew the cap. Drink from the bottle. Screw the cap back on. Put the bottle down. Open the spreadsheet file with the mouse. Type figures into the cells. Press the Enter key. Highlight a column with the mouse. Click the format menu. Shift position in the chair. Cross the left leg over the right. Uncross the legs. Place both feet on the floor. Open the browser tab with the mouse. Read the page on the screen. Click the back button. Open the online document. Type a paragraph of text. Click the save icon. Open the video call window. Speak into the microphone to the team. Click the mute button. Click the end call button. Open the file folder with the mouse. Drag a file into the shared folder. Close the laptop lid halfway. Stand up from the chair. Walk to the kitchen and back. Sit down on the chair again. Open the laptop lid. Continue typing on the keyboard. Roll the mouse wheel to scroll. Click the mouse to open a new email. Type the recipient address on the keyboard. Type the message body. Click the send button. Push the chair back from the desk. Stand up. Stretch both arms overhead.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk chair. Walk to the kitchen. Say to Member 2: "I'll get the bread and salad." Open the refrigerator door. Take out the salad bowl. Take out the cheese. Take out the tomatoes. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a knife. Close the drawer. Place the tomatoes on the cutting board. Cut the tomatoes into slices with the knife. Open the cupboard door. Take out two plates. Close the cupboard door. Place the plates on the counter. Put bread on both plates. Arrange tomato slices on the plates. Add cheese slices to both plates. Hand one plate to Member 2. Pick up the salad bowl. Carry the bowl to the table. Place the bowl in the middle of the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the table. Pick up the fork. Eat the salad. Cut the bread with the knife. Eat the bread. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Talk with Member 2 about the afternoon schedule. Put the fork down. Stand up from the chair. Pick up both plates. Carry the plates to the sink. Turn the tap on. Rinse the plates under the water. Place the plates in the dishwasher. Turn the tap off.

Walk back to the desk in the living room. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Open the laptop lid. Type the login password. Press the Enter key. Move the right hand to the mouse. Click the email icon. Read the incoming emails. Click open the first message. Type a reply on the keyboard. Click the send button. Open the budget spreadsheet. Type figures into the rows. Press the Tab key. Click the column header with the mouse. Click the sort option. Scroll down the sheet with the mouse wheel. Pick up the water bottle. Drink from the bottle. Put the bottle down. Open the browser tab. Read the grant guideline page. Click the download button. Click the file in the download list. Open the document reader. Read the document on the screen. Move the hand back to the keyboard. Type a summary paragraph. Click the save icon. Open the messaging window. Type a message to the colleague. Press Enter. Read the reply. Type a follow-up message. Stand up from the chair. Walk to the window. Pull the curtain to the side. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Adjust the desk lamp head. Continue typing on the keyboard. Click the mouse to close the window. Push the chair back. Stand up. Stretch the back by leaning backward. Sit down again. Turn the head toward the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short tea break with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk chair. Walk to the kitchen. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch down. Open the cupboard door. Take out two mugs. Close the cupboard door. Place the mugs on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out two tea bags. Close the drawer. Drop one tea bag into each mug. Pour hot water from the kettle into both mugs. Pick up the milk carton from the refrigerator. Pour milk into the mug. Place the carton back in the refrigerator. Say to Member 2: "Tea's ready." Hand one mug to Member 2. Pick up the other mug. Sit down at the table. Blow on the tea. Sip the tea. Talk with Member 2 about the day's work. Put the mug down on the table. Stand up. Carry both mugs to the sink. Place the mugs in the sink.

Walk from the kitchen to the desk in the living room. Sit down on the chair. Open the laptop lid. Type on the keyboard. Move the right hand to the mouse. Click open the task list. Read the items in the list. Click the first item with the mouse. Type notes in the text field. Press the Enter key. Click the second item. Open the linked document. Read the paragraphs on the screen. Scroll down with the mouse wheel. Pick up the phone from the desk. Press the phone screen on. Read the messages on the phone. Type a reply on the phone screen. Press the send button. Put the phone back on the desk. Place both hands on the keyboard. Type a report section. Press the Backspace key. Retype the sentence. Click the mouse to open the image file. Look at the image on the screen. Click the close button. Open the browser tab. Click the search bar. Type the search terms on the keyboard. Press Enter. Read the results list. Click the first result link. Scroll down the page. Click the bookmark icon. Close the tab. Open the shared document. Type two paragraphs. Click the save icon. Push the chair back from the desk. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Fill a glass with water from the tap. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Place the glass on the desk. Type on the keyboard. Click the mouse to close the laptop halfway.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with Member 2, watching TV and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Press the laptop lid shut. Stand up from the desk chair. Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa beside Member 2. Pick up the TV remote from the armrest. Press the power button on the remote. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the sofa cushion. Lean back against the sofa backrest. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Press the phone screen on. Open the music application. Tap a playlist. Place the phone on the armrest. Turn the head toward the TV screen. Pick up the remote. Press the volume down button. Put the remote down. Say to Member 2: "This one's good." Pick up the phone. Tap the next track. Put the phone down. Lean back on the sofa. Place both feet on the floor. Turn the head toward Member 2. Talk about the dinner plan.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Press the TV power button on the remote. Stand up from the sofa. Pick up the cushions from the floor. Place the cushions on the sofa. Pick up the empty glass from the coffee table. Carry the glass to the kitchen. Place the glass in the sink. Walk back to the living room. Pick up the newspapers from the coffee table. Stack the newspapers. Place the stack on the shelf. Pick up the pen from the coffee table. Place the pen in the drawer. Close the drawer. Walk to the corner of the room. Pick up the vacuum cleaner handle. Press the vacuum power button on. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pull the vacuum cleaner backward. Push it under the coffee table. Press the vacuum power button off. Wrap the cord around the hook. Place the vacuum cleaner in the corner. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the coffee table surface. Say to Member 2: "I'll take the cloth back." Walk to the kitchen. Hang the cloth on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Say to Member 2: "I'll chop the vegetables." Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the chicken. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a knife and a cutting board. Close the drawer. Place the cutting board on the counter. Place the vegetables on the board. Cut the vegetables into pieces with the knife. Slide the pieces into a bowl. Place the chicken on the board. Cut the chicken into strips. Pick up the frying pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on. Pour oil into the pan. Add the chicken to the pan. Stir with the spatula. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir again. Add salt from the shaker. Press the power button off. Open the cupboard door. Take out two plates. Close the cupboard door. Place the plates on the counter. Spoon the food onto both plates. Hand one plate to Member 2. Carry the plate to the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the fork. Eat the food. Talk with Member 2 about the weekend plan. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Put the fork down. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink.

Open the dishwasher door. Pick up the plates from the sink. Place the plates in the dishwasher rack. Pick up the glasses. Place the glasses in the rack. Pick up the forks and knives. Place the cutlery in the basket. Pick up the frying pan. Place the pan in the lower rack. Place the spatula in the rack. Add a detergent tablet to the dispenser. Close the dispenser lid. Press the dishwasher power button on. Press the start button. Close the dishwasher door. Pick up the cloth from the hook. Wipe the counter surface. Wipe the cutting board. Place the cutting board in the rack. Turn the tap on. Rinse the cloth under the water. Wring the cloth with both hands. Turn the tap off. Hang the cloth on the hook. Press the range hood button off. Press the kitchen light switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and watching TV, joined by Member 2 until 20:00
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote from the armrest. Press the power button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Put the remote down. Pick up the book from the side table. Open the book at the bookmark. Read the page. Turn the page with the right hand. Look up at the TV screen. Turn another page. Place the bookmark between the pages. Close the book. Place the book on the side table. Pick up the remote. Press the volume up button. Put the remote down. Turn the head toward Member 2. Say: "See you tomorrow." Watch Member 2 walk to Bedroom 2. Pick up the book again. Open the book. Read the next page. Turn the page. Pick up the phone from the sofa. Press the screen on. Tap a message. Type a short reply. Press send. Put the phone down. Pick up the book. Read two pages. Turn the pages. Close the book. Place it on the side table. Pick up the remote. Press the power button and turn the TV off. Stand up from the sofa. Pick up the empty glass. Carry it to the kitchen. Place it in the sink. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Push the bathroom door open. Step inside. Press the light switch on. Press the water heater switch on. Open the shower curtain. Step into the shower area. Turn the shower valve to the left. Put the right hand under the water. Adjust the valve. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the left palm. Close the cap. Put the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the hair with both hands. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Put the soap back on the holder. Rinse the body under the water. Turn the shower valve to the right and stop the water. Open the shower curtain. Step out. Pick up the towel from the rack. Rub the hair with the towel. Wipe the body with the towel. Wrap the towel around the waist. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the tap. Spit into the sink. Rinse the toothbrush. Place it in the holder. Wipe the face with the towel. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into Bedroom 1. Press the light switch on. Take off the shirt. Drop it into the laundry basket. Take off the trousers. Drop them into the laundry basket. Take off the socks. Drop them into the laundry basket. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the pyjama top. Take out the pyjama bottoms. Close the wardrobe door. Put on the pyjama top. Put on the pyjama trousers. Pick up the phone from the desk. Plug the charger cable into the phone. Plug the charger into the wall socket. Place the phone on the bedside table. Press the fan switch on. Pick up the water glass from the table. Drink water. Put the glass down on the bedside table. Pull the blanket back. Sit on the edge of the bed. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Read one page. Close the book. Place the book on the bedside table. Press the light switch off. Lie down on the bed.

Lie in bed with eyes closed. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn onto the left side. Bend the knees. Place the left arm under the pillow. Breathe steadily. Turn onto the back. Place both hands on the blanket. Turn the head to the right. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Stretch the legs. Turn onto the back again. Adjust the pillow with the right hand. Place the right arm along the side. Lie still with eyes closed. Continue sleeping.
